messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-98765 — GPU memory pressure detected in us-west-2 (pool: render-pool-a). 80% of GPUs reporting cudaMalloc failures. Auto-escalation in 2m if unacked.

mira: acked PD-98765 — I'm on it. seeing a spike in kvcache evictions in the metrics.

sam: thanks mira. any customer-facing impact flagged?

cs-rep: getting a support ticket from AcmeCorp complaining about slow generations and some 500s. they say latency jumped ~3s starting ~5m ago.

jordan: can we reroute AcmeCorp traffic off that pool to a colder pool? is there capacity?

mira: checking capacity. us-west-2 warm pool has 4 free nodes, but their SLA requires dedicated. we can temporarily route to general-hosted fallback model variant.

ops-bot: runbook step: increase prefetch disabled for render-pool-a and trigger graceful eviction. Command suggestion: ```curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/pools/render-pool-a/actions/evict?mode=graceful```

mira: running eviction now. will also set pool.kvcache.prefetch=false. posting logs: ```2024-11-02T05:47:11Z EVictStart pool=render-pool-a reason=kv-evict-storm```.

sam: mira, can you paste a short nvidia-smi and dmesg snippet? Curious if it's OOM killer or CUDA alloc fails.

mira: nvidia-smi during spike: ```+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+| NVIDIA-SMI 525.60.13 | Driver Version: 525.60.13 |CUDA Version: 12.1 |+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id      Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC | Fan Temp Perf Pwr:Usage/Cap | Memory-Usage | GPU-Util |
|   0  A100-SXM4-40G     Off  | 00000000:3E:00.0 Off | 0 | 35C P0  123W / 400W | 38245MiB / 40960MiB | 92% |``` then repeated cudaMalloc failures in logs: ```cudaMalloc returned out of memory at kv_cache.cc:142```

jordan: that looks like fragmentation + reclaim latency. Could be a long-running large model pinned memory. Any heavy jobs?

mira: yes fn-infer-qa has a long-lived VMap instance hogging KV cache on GPU 0-2. Posting process list: ```ps aux | grep fn-infer-qa```

sam: mitigation plan: 1) drain the offending instances (scale down fn-infer-qa in render-pool-a), 2) reroute customer traffic to fallback-hosted variant, 3) bump auto-eviction threshold to free up fragmented memory, 4) monitor for recurrence. who does step 1?

mira: I can scale down the deployment now: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy fn-infer-qa --replicas=0 --context=cluster-usw2```. doing it now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-98765 acknowledged by mira at 2024-11-02T05:48:30Z. Auto-escalation cancelled.

ops-bot: started reroute job for AcmeCorp to model-redwood-fallback-v2: ```/infra/routes reroute --customer AcmeCorp --from pool:render-pool-a --to variant:model-redwood-fallback-v2 --timeout 20m```

cs-rep: update sent to AcmeCorp: "we're mitigating GPU memory pressure, temporarily routing requests to a fallback variant — you may notice slightly different latency/outputs. We'll follow up."

jordan: after scale-down, GPU memory usage dropped on nodes 0-2 and evictions decreased. dmesg now shows no recent cudaAlloc failures.

mira: keeping pool in degraded mode: pool.set(degraded=true) and adding a TTL for 30m so autoscaler doesn't repopulate.

sam: good. next steps: create an action ticket to investigate fn-infer-qa memory behavior (trace KV cache growth and lifecycle), propose better isolation for long-lived jobs. assign to eng-runtime.

next-oncall: i'm taking the handoff at 05:56 UTC — i'll watch for reoccurrence and coordinate deeper root cause analysis. leave any open runbook steps in the incident ticket PD-98765.

mira: handing off now — notes: scaled-down fn-infer-qa, rerouted AcmeCorp, set pool degraded, sent customer comms. will follow up in ticket with logs and heap snapshots.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 2024-11-02T05:57:20Z — PD-98765 set to resolved. Further analysis ticket: RT-3221 created and assigned to eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:
